assetProvenance.generationMethod: 24 dedicated bitmap generations from the built-in image_gen model, three states per word, each using the accepted mit / miss keypose raster as a style and character reference
assetProvenance.runtimeSourceScan: all runtime state sources and storyboard image layers resolve under public/assets/replica/ten-tain-v3

notes: All eight word scenes use 24 newly generated bitmap poses made for this episode; no vector or SVG stand-ins are in the runtime set.
The generated cutouts follow the accepted mit / miss grammar: one black Xiaohei, sparse hand-drawn ink, restrained orange/cyan/gray props, and transparent margins.
The continuous stage uses the same static-card and word-assembly choreography as mit / miss, with a visible before / change / result rhythm.
Every runtime source resolves under public/assets/replica/ten-tain-v3; failed provider outputs and the earlier vector experiment remain in work/experiments only.

shots.visualAction: The character gathers three blank note cards and closes them into a large orange folder held against the chest.
shots.purpose: Shows checked information staying with the holder instead of slipping away.

shots.visualAction: The character guides large blue books over the rim of an open cyan-and-white box until they are inside.
shots.purpose: Makes the idea of something being kept within a boundary concrete.

shots.visualAction: A three-piece orange-and-blue tower is aligned from a leaning state into a stable upright result.
shots.purpose: Uses a stable built arrangement to represent keeping a condition in place.

shots.meaning: get and take possession of something
shots.visualAction: A blank orange permission envelope is transferred from a small gray pedestal into the receiver's hand.
shots.purpose: Shows permission becoming available and held by the receiver.

shots.visualAction: The character lowers a striped orange barrier and stops a blank blue ball from crossing.
shots.purpose: Uses a clear boundary and stopped motion to convey being held back.

shots.visualAction: A Xiaohei pushes a wide orange bridge beam into a level, supported result.
shots.purpose: Shows effort being held up and guided toward a stable target.

shots.visualAction: One Xiaohei performs with a large orange ball under a simple cyan stage arch and keeps attention on the show.
shots.purpose: Represents attention being held through an engaging performance.

shots.meaning: hold yourself back from an action
shots.visualAction: The character pulls both hands back and turns away from an untouched large orange sweet on a cyan tray.
shots.purpose: Shows deliberate restraint by leaving the tempting object alone.
